turns.say: I found the manual for our generator.
turns.reply:
Never run a generator, grill, or any other gasoline-, propane-, or charcoal-burning device inside a home, garage, or carport, or near doors, windows, or vents. Keep generators outside, at least 20 feet from doors, windows, and vents. Don't heat your home with a gas oven. Carbon monoxide has no smell or color, and it kills.
(Shown in case your question involves this.)
